papers.title: Beyond representational alignment with brain-guided language models for robust reasoning
papers.what: Human fMRI signals from reasoning regions are turned into steering directions that raise deductive-reasoning accuracy by up to 13 points across ten LLMs (1.5B-72B), with gains orthogonal to language-only training.
papers.builds_on: Chain-of-Thought (Wei 2023), DeepSeek-R1 (2025), Brain Science Foundation Models

papers.title: Organize then Retrieve: Hierarchical Memory Navigation for Efficient Agents
papers.what: HORMA organizes agent experience into a file-system-like hierarchy with summaries pointing to raw trajectories, keeping detail reachable while holding the working context small on long-horizon tasks.
papers.builds_on: Memory Mechanisms Survey (Huang 2026), Agent AI Survey (Durante 2024)

papers.title: Fine-tuning Multi-modal LLMs with ART: Art-based Reinforcement Training
papers.what: ART specializes a frozen multimodal LLM by optimizing only its raw pixel input, keeping the model's computational graph untouched so it stays usable in high-throughput serving engines.
papers.builds_on: No direct library parent; closest neighbors SigLIP (Zhai 2023), PyVision (Zhao 2025)

papers.title: Flaws in the LLM Automation Narrative
papers.what: A code-writing data-analysis benchmark with human expert baselines shows experts beat a frontier LLM on average and vary less, arguing benchmarks must report variance and error magnitude, not just mean accuracy.
